_comment: THE QUEUE. One repository at a time, to completion, then a Forgejo release,
then the next. See docs/PROGRAM.md for the definition of done.
Ordered by TOOLCHAIN TRACTABILITY, not by interest. Python first because
uv + ruff + pytest is the toolchain proven here; Shell needs a shellcheck
gate that does not exist yet; Rust needs the whole Rust arm. Pointing the
pipeline at a language it cannot gate produces confident green on work that
`blocked_on` is why a rung cannot start, in the loop's own goal ids. A rung
with an unmet blocker is SKIPPED rather than attempted -- attempting it
wastes cycles and, worse, can produce a release that passed because the

rungs.note: 11 -> 26 tests, 6 PRs merged. Release not yet cut.

Autodev's own source. Nine goals sanitise its documentation to the committed example values so the repository is publishable from source rather than by a scrub. It edits a CLONE and opens PRs; the running harness is root-owned, so it cannot modify itself directly and the operator deploys deliberately.
7 goals done, 10 PRs merged; adoption findings still refilling the queue
shellcheck gate landed (L5-4). Still the ONLY repo carrying the live github.server_url guard, so its first PR needs the bootstrap fix (L5-5) before anything else can merge.

ASSESSED 2026-09-08 and it is EMPTY: 0 Rust files, 0 Cargo.toml, 11 component dirs that are broken gitlinks with no .gitmodules anywhere in history, 5 shell scripts, 0 CI runs, one doc commit since July. The real code moved to aphelion/embeddenator-* (11 Rust repos). Forgejo's 577 MB is a stale metric -- do not trust that column for any repo. mycelium's own ADR-004 already ruled it prior art, not a prerequisite. Retarget at aphelion/* if the work is wanted.

CHOSEN over CSD, on evidence. Closer to done by a wide margin: 1260/1399 tracked issues closed (90%), builds clean in 7.2s with 0 warnings, 5976/5977 tests pass in 224s. 349K Rust LOC, 58 crates, 1 todo!() in the whole tree. It has an EBNF grammar, a conformance corpus, 36 ADRs and a capability matrix generated by executable probes -- stated intent at the granularity this pipeline consumes.

NOT an autonomous target, though it has higher utility if finished -- it is the critical path everything else is parked behind. Two reasons it is not for this pipeline yet: its next moves are OPERATOR DECISIONS an agent may not make (OD-17, the quant floor policy, the episodic partition contract, five licence rulings), and the reason region has no validated training objective after two KILL verdicts -- that is research, not a ticket. And the operator is driving it hard: 369 commits in 14 days across 46 branches, so an autonomous loop there collides with live human work. Revisit when the decisions are made and the branch churn settles.

demo_apps.what: new repositories in the collective org demonstrating what the completed repos can do
demo_apps.why: the first honest test of whether those repos are usable by someone who did not write them, and where DX findings actually come from
demo_apps.needs: autodev able to create repos in cabal-collective

hyphae.what: libraries extending the Mycelium ecosystem, targeting AI/ML, each in its own repo
hyphae.why: writing idiomatic libraries in a language the models have never seen, against a spec that exists only in this fleet -- the bleeding-edge test, and deliberately last because everything before it is what makes it survivable
